description: This source file implements the driver for the AR8216/AR8337 switch chip, including hardware initialization, port setup, VLAN and mirror configurations, LED control, PHY fixups, and ARL table management, specifically tailored for the ar8327 and ar8337 chips within the Linux driver framework.

classes.name: ar8327_led
classes.description: Structure representing an LED controlled via the driver, including configuration, state, workqueue, and lock data.

classes.name: ar8327_data
classes.description: Structure holding switch-specific data such as LED pointers, VLAN info, and port configurations.

classes.name: ar8xxx_priv
classes.description: Primary private data structure for switch driver instance, holding hardware info, port states, and LEDs.

methods.name: u32 ar8327_get_pad_cfg(struct ar8327_pad_cfg * cfg)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration value for a given pad configuration.

methods.name: void ar8327_phy_rgmii_set(struct ar8xxx_priv * priv,struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Configures RGMII PHY interface settings based on device tree properties.

methods.name: void ar8327_phy_fixup(struct ar8xxx_priv * priv,int phy)
methods.description: Performs PHY register fixups depending on chip revision for proper operation.

methods.name: u32 ar8327_get_port_init_status(struct ar8327_port_cfg * cfg)
methods.description: Generates port status configuration based on provided port configuration.

methods.name: void ar8327_set_led_pattern(struct ar8xxx_priv * priv,unsigned int led_num,enum ar8327_led_pattern pattern)
methods.description: Sets the pattern of a specific LED based on the driver configuration.

methods.name: void ar8327_led_work_func(struct work_struct * work)
methods.description: Workqueue handler to apply LED pattern changes asynchronously.

methods.name: void ar8327_led_schedule_change(struct ar8327_led * aled,u8 pattern)
methods.description: Schedules a LED pattern change via workqueue if the pattern differs from current.

methods.name: int ar8327_led_blink_set(struct led_classdev * led_cdev,unsigned long * delay_on,unsigned long * delay_off)
methods.description: Configures LED blinking behavior, falling back to hardware support or software blink.

methods.name: void ar8327_led_set_brightness(struct led_classdev * led_cdev,enum led_brightness brightness)
methods.description: Sets the brightness/state of an LED (on/off).

methods.name: int ar8327_led_create(struct ar8xxx_priv * priv,const struct ar8327_led_info * led_info)
methods.description: Creates and registers an LED with the specified configuration.

methods.name: int ar8327_hw_config_pdata(struct ar8xxx_priv * priv,struct ar8327_platform_data * pdata)
methods.description: Configures hardware based on platform data, including pads, LEDs, and SGMII settings.

methods.description: Configures hardware using device tree properties (if available).

methods.description: Initializes the hardware, allocating data structures and configuring via platform data or device tree.

methods.description: Cleans up resources and LEDs during driver removal.

methods.name: void ar8327_init_globals(struct ar8xxx_priv * priv)
methods.description: Initializes global switch settings such as port forwarding, multicast handling, and counters.

methods.description: Initializes port-specific registers and configurations.

methods.description: Reads current port link status and flow control bits.

methods.description: Fetches Energy-Efficient Ethernet status for a port.
